args.title: Fix parser shape validation on Windows line endings and trailing blank lines
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Update parseStatement in src/ingest/parser.ts to trim carriage returns (\r) and filter out empty lines so trailing blank lines do not trigger shape validation errors on the row past the last transaction.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/ingest/parser.ts, text is split only on \n without handling potential \r characters from Windows line endings (CRLF), and only a single trailing empty line is popped, so any extra whitespace lines or carriage returns result in empty lines being parsed as data rows and failing shape validation. We should update parseStatement to trim carriage returns and filter out empty lines so trailing blank lines do not trigger shape validation errors on the row past the last transaction.
